<timestamp>Sunday, Aug 2, 2026, 6:30 PM (UTC-10)</timestamp>
<user_query>
You are on the operator’s Windows machine.

## Ask
Alex: **the remaining will be regular space** — on the microSD that now has one ~19GB `F: UBUNTU` partition and ~100GB unallocated, create a second partition using **all remaining space** as regular storage (NTFS, friendly label e.g. `DATA` or `STORAGE`).

## Target — RE-VERIFY by serial before touching
- Generic STORAGE DEVICE, serial **`000000000819`**, ~119 GB USB
- Should currently have: one ~19GB FAT32 `UBUNTU` (likely F:)
- Do NOT touch C/D/E, SanDisk installer stick, or other disks

## Do
1. Confirm disk by serial `000000000819`
2. Create primary partition in remaining free space → format NTFS quick → label `DATA` (or `STORAGE`) → assign next free letter (G: preferred if free)
3. Verify: two partitions — UBUNTU ~19GB + DATA ~rest; report letters
4. Update note `Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\notes\microsd-ubuntu-staging-layout.md` if it exists

Return before/after layout.
</user_query>
I'll verify the microSD by serial first, then create the NTFS DATA partition in the remaining free space.

content.text: Disk 3 matches serial `000000000819` — one ~19GB `F: UBUNTU` partition. Creating NTFS `DATA` in the remaining space as `G:`.

input.command: $disk = Get-Disk | Where-Object { $_.SerialNumber -replace '\s','' -eq '000000000819' }; if (-not $disk) { throw 'Target disk serial 000000000819 not found' }; Write-Host "BEFORE Disk#$($disk.Number) Size=$($disk.Size) Style=$($disk.PartitionStyle)"; Get-Partition -DiskNumber $disk.Number | Format-Table PartitionNumber, DriveLetter, Size, Type, Offset -AutoSize; Get-PartitionSupportedSize -DiskNumber $disk.Number | Format-List; $gInUse = Get-Volume -DriveLetter G -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($gInUse) { throw 'G: already in use' }; Write-Host 'G: is free. Creating partition...'; $part = New-Partition -DiskNumber $disk.Number -UseMaximumSize -DriveLetter G; Write-Host "Created Partition#$($part.PartitionNumber) letter=$($part.DriveLetter) size=$($part.Size)"; Format-Volume -DriveLetter G -FileSystem NTFS -NewFileSystemLabel 'DATA' -Confirm:$false | Format-List
input.description: Create and format DATA partition on microSD

content.text: Partitioning needs elevation. Retrying with admin privileges via diskpart.

input.command:
$disk = Get-Disk | Where-Object { ($_.SerialNumber -replace '\s','') -eq '000000000819' }; if (-not $disk) { throw 'Target not found' }; $n = $disk.Number; Write-Host "Using Disk $n serial verified"; @"
select disk $n
detail disk
list partition
list volume
create partition primary
format fs=ntfs label=DATA quick
assign letter=G
list partition
list volume
detail disk
"@ | Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\microsd-data-part.txt" -Encoding ASCII; Start-Process -FilePath diskpart.exe -ArgumentList "/s `"$env:TEMP\microsd-data-part.txt`"" -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru | Select-Object Id, ExitCode; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Get-Partition -DiskNumber $n | Format-Table PartitionNumber, DriveLetter, Size, Type -AutoSize; Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -in @('F','G') } | Format-Table DriveLetter, FileSystemLabel, FileSystem, Size -AutoSize
input.description: Elevated diskpart create NTFS DATA partition

content.text: Partition created successfully. Verifying final layout and updating the note.

input.command:
$note = 'D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\notes\microsd-ubuntu-staging-layout.md'
$content = @'
# microSD layout - Ubuntu installer staging

**Date:** 2026-08-03 (operator local ~2026-08-02 evening HST)  
**Disk:** Generic STORAGE DEVICE, serial `000000000819`, UniqueId contains `000000000819`, ~119 GB USB (Disk # may drift)

## Before (this session)
- One partition: **F:** UBUNTU (FAT32 ~19 GB)
- Remainder unallocated (~100 GB)

## After (DATA partition added)
- Partition 1: **F:** **UBUNTU** — FAT32 ~19 GB (installer staging)
- Partition 2: **G:** **DATA** — NTFS ~100 GB (all remaining space, quick format)
- No unallocated space left on this card

## Earlier history (same card)
- Had been three partitions (BOOT / Clean / unlabeled), then cleaned to GPT single ~19 GiB UBUNTU + unallocated; then DATA filled the rest

Only this serial. Never C/D/E, JMicron 2TB (E:), or SanDisk Cruzer Ubuntu stick.

Set-Content -Path $note -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host 'Updated note OK'
